title: Lesson 47 - Activation Targets and Setup: What an Activation Is and Connecting a Destination
description: Publish Activations within Data 360, starting with what an activation is, the activation targets available, and configuring a target and its marketing or advertising destination.

questions.question: A consultant needs to send an audience to an advertising platform such as Google Ads. What must be created first?
options: An activation target that stores the platform authentication and authorization information
A Segment Membership data model object
questions.explanation: An activation target holds the credentials and configuration for the destination platform; external advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta are reached through an activation target.

questions.question: Which activation type cannot be published to an activation target?
questions.explanation: Dynamic segments run by API call only, do not persist membership, and cannot be scheduled or published to activation targets; standard and waterfall segments can be published.

questions.question: An activation is saved against a segment that is still processing. How may it behave?
options: It publishes instantly regardless of segment state
It can remain in an error state until the segment finishes processing
It converts the segment to a standard segment
questions.explanation: Activating a segment that is still processing can leave the activation in an error state until the segment completes, so activate from an active or published segment.
